ev-activate.intro.say: This signs this machine in to Evalation.

ev-activate.damaged.say: This machine needs to sign in to Evalation again. Sign in with the same account as before.

ev-activate.damaged-named.say: This machine needs to sign in to Evalation again. Sign in with <email>.

ev-activate.already.say: This machine is already signed in to Evalation. To use a different account, run /ev-remove, then /ev-activate.

ev-activate.explain.say: You sign in with Google or Microsoft in your browser. Evalation never sees your password.

ev-activate.provider.ask: Which account will you sign in with?

ev-activate.provider-microsoft-first.ask: Which account will you sign in with?

ev-activate.other-way.say: You can sign in with Google or Microsoft. If you have neither, email support@evalation.ai.

ev-activate.failed-before.say: Signing in with <provider> didn't work last time.

ev-activate.no-browser.say: No browser opened. Open this address to sign in:

ev-activate.browser.say: Your browser should now show the sign-in page. If it doesn't, open this address:

ev-activate.waiting.say: It waits up to five minutes. If the page shows an error, tell me what it says.

ev-activate.signed-in.say: Signed in as <email>. This machine is ready.

ev-activate.awaiting.say: Your request to use <whose> Evalation credits went to <owner>. You can run Evalation once they approve it.

ev-activate.unverified-google.say: Google hasn't confirmed this address is yours, so you can't use your organisation's Evalation credits. Confirm the address in your Google account, then run /ev-remove and /ev-activate.

ev-activate.unverified-microsoft.say: Microsoft hasn't confirmed this address is yours, so you can't use your organisation's Evalation credits. Email support@evalation.ai and we'll help.

ev-activate.machine-awaiting.say: This machine needs <owner> to approve it, and we've asked them.

ev-activate.not-emailed.say: Evalation couldn't email <owner> for their approval. Email support@evalation.ai and we'll send it.

ev-activate.company-later.say: We'll send your request to use <whose> Evalation credits to <owner> shortly. You'll be asked which company this is for next time you sign in.

ev-activate.company-later-machine.say: We'll ask <owner> to approve this machine shortly. You'll be asked which company this is for next time you sign in.

ev-activate.company-open.ask: Which company are you using Evalation for? Pick Other and type its name, such as a client's.

options.label: I'll type the name
options.description: Pick Other and type the company's name.

options.label: Leave it for now
options.description: You'll be asked next time you sign in.

ev-activate.company-unsent.say: Evalation couldn't save the company just now. You'll be asked next time you sign in.

ev-activate.company-unusable.say: Type a company name of up to 120 characters.

ev-activate.company.ask: Which company are you using Evalation for? Pick <company>, or type another name, such as a client's.

ev-activate.company-ready.say: Saves this sign-in as being for <company>.

ev-activate.company-leave-means.say: You'll be asked next time you sign in.

ev-activate.other-computer.say: To use Evalation on another computer, sign in there with the same account.

ev-activate.next.say: Next, run /ev-packs to choose what your code is checked against.

ev-activate.stopped.ask: The sign-in stopped. What would you like to do?

options.label: Sign in again
options.description: Choose an account and start again.

ev-activate.error-page.say: The sign-in page showed an error. Try the other account, or email support@evalation.ai with what the page says.

ev-activate.nothing-happened.say: The sign-in is still waiting. Open this address in your browser to sign in:

ev-activate.still-waiting.say: The sign-in is still waiting. It finishes by itself once the page says the sign-in was received.

ev-activate.which-account.say: Sign in with the account you want your pack credits kept under, and use it on any other computer too.

ev-activate.stopped-stop.say: Run /ev-activate when you're ready to sign in.

ev-activate.declined-google-first.ask: Which account will you sign in with now?

ev-activate.declined-microsoft-first.ask: Which account will you sign in with now?

ev-activate.declined-stop.say: Run /ev-activate when you're ready to sign in.

ev-activate.timed-out.say: The sign-in wasn't finished within five minutes. Run /ev-activate to try again.

ev-activate.fault.say: The sign-in failed because of a fault on our side. Email support@evalation.ai and we'll fix it.

ev-activate.page-received.say: Sign-in received. You can close this tab and go back to Claude Code.

ev-activate.page-declined.say: The sign-in didn't finish. You can close this tab and go back to Claude Code.

ev-activate.refused.say: The sign-in didn't go through. Run /ev-activate to try again, and if it fails again, email support@evalation.ai.

ev-activate.refused-unrecognised.say: The sign-in was refused. Email support@evalation.ai and we'll help you sign in.

ev-activate.server-error.say: Evalation couldn't finish the sign-in just now. Run /ev-activate again in a few minutes.

ev-activate.no-code.say: The sign-in came back unfinished. Run /ev-activate to try again.

ev-activate.wrong-sign-in.say: The sign-in that came back didn't match the one that started. Run /ev-activate to try again.

ev-activate.wrong-sign-in-twice.say: That shouldn't happen twice. Email support@evalation.ai.

ev-activate.no-listener.say: Something on this machine stopped the sign-in from reaching Claude Code. Run /ev-activate to try again.

ev-activate.no-listener-twice.say: Something on this machine is blocking the sign-in. Email support@evalation.ai.

ev-activate.no-key-store.say: This machine has no password store Evalation can use. Run the line below in a terminal, then restart Claude Code and run /ev-activate again.

ev-activate.holds-a-key.say: This machine is already signed in. Run /ev-account to see its pack credits.

ev-activate.unclear.say: This machine's sign-in couldn't be read. Unlock this machine's password store (Keychain on a Mac), then run /ev-activate again.

ev-activate.unreachable.say: Evalation couldn't be reached. Check this machine is online, then run /ev-activate again.

ev-activate.unreadable.say: Evalation sent back an answer it couldn't read. Run /ev-activate to try again.

ev-activate.unreadable-twice.say: Evalation isn't answering properly. Email support@evalation.ai.

ev-activate.waiting-script.say: Waiting up to five minutes for you to finish signing in.
